capture_provenance.display_cache: Explicit viewport/source cache; not neural feature reuse.
capture_provenance.result_and_detail_pickups: Same capture/actions, revised viewport framing and lighting only. No pose generation or video interpolation.
capture_provenance.rendering: Mesa software viewport on GPU container; the GPU is used for actual neural inference.
capture_provenance.limits: Inference time after person selection includes model loading, excludes detection, retargeting, export, viewport preparation and human operation. Not a consumer-GPU or under-60-second claim.
capture_provenance.viewport_preparation: Separate recording-time cost. Workbench-shadow hero preparation about 367 seconds on the software renderer, not GPU inference or a consumer desktop benchmark.

audio.opening: Audio supplied with the user video, synchronized to the full first 25 seconds.
audio.bed: Original synthesized ambient composition, no downloaded music.
